payload.body: Fixed in PR #7. Object reads now owner-scoped by default: FrickStore.isObjectVisibleToUser scopes a type to its owner when it declares an owner field (new server-only ObjectDef.ownerField, or the ownerUserId convention). Unified read pipeline (ownership -> policy hooks -> grant relaxation) now shared by WS snapshot, live delta fan-out, HTTP /objects list, and search-hit filtering. Allow-all is explicit opt-in via createFrickServer({ objectVisibility: { mode: 'tenantWide' } }). Grant accept live-pushes the record; revoke/leave live-pushes a removal. New apps/server/tests/owner-scoped-reads.test.ts; full server suite (1653) green incl FR-116/FR-70. Real RangerCRM iOS client: test_Account_CRUD ('got 3') now passes. CHANGELOG 0.3.1 notes the behavioral change (allow-all relied-upon apps must add an owner field, set mode tenantWide, or opt types out via ownerFields).
